newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - Feb 26.

text.p: * Dell Computer Corp was up more than a point in after-hours trading Tuesday, at 73-1/4 after closing at 72-1/8. In the late afternoon, Dell reported fourth quarter net income of $1.01 per share, up from $0.35 a year earlier.
* IDT Corp is expected to report a second quarter loss per share of $0.08, compared with a loss of $0.30 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 7-1/2 Tuesday.
* U.S.-Swedish drug firm Pharmacia & Upjohn said Wednesday it might not achieve its goal of 25 percent operating profit margin by 1998. Shares closed at 37-3/4.
* ValuJet Inc is expected to report a $0.30 per share loss for the 1996 fourth quarter and a loss of $0.68 for the year, according to First Call. The stock closed at 7-3/8.
